title: Continuous Learning Intelligence — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Updates its knowledge and skills from new evidence while checking for regressions and outdated beliefs. A proposed future-grade AI capability that ingests new evidence, updates its knowledge and skills, and continuously checks for regressions, outdated beliefs, and drift. Instead of freezing a model at training time, the intelligence maintains a living belief set: each update is validated against a regression suite of prior capabilities, and beliefs that contradict verified new evidence are revised or retired with an audit trail.
capabilities: Ingest new evidence and integrate it into existing knowledge
Run regression checks so new learning does not erase prior skills
Detect outdated beliefs that conflict with verified evidence
Retire or revise beliefs with a full audit trail
Schedule learning effort toward the most uncertain knowledge
